components.name: Self-Service Portal Frontend
components.purpose: Delivers self-service web access for policyholders to manage policies and submit claims.
components.rationale: Provides modern, scalable static web hosting with global distribution and seamless CI/CD integration.
trade_offs: Limited to static asset hosting requiring separate backend API integrations
components.security_considerations: Integrates with Entra External ID for secure policyholder authentication.

components.name: Policy Core Microservices
components.purpose: Executes core policy lifecycle, rating, product configuration, and business logic operations.
components.rationale: Serverless container platform enabling microservice modularity, rapid scaling, and zero-downtime deployments.
trade_offs: Requires containerization and microservices refactoring from legacy monolith
components.security_considerations: Enforces identity verification via Managed Identities and private network isolation.

components.validation_reason: Relies on assumption ASM_04 for SOAP-to-REST translation facade.
components.name: API Management & Broker Gateway
components.purpose: Exposes managed REST APIs and provides SOAP-to-REST facade for legacy broker integrations.
components.rationale: Centralizes API policies, security, rate limiting, and SOAP transformation without altering backend code.
trade_offs: Introduces gateway latency overhead for API mediation
components.security_considerations: Enforces WS-Security, Mutual TLS, and rate limiting for external integrations.

components.validation_reason: Relies on assumption ASM_01 for PL/SQL code migration to PostgreSQL pgSQL.
components.name: Relational Operational Database
components.purpose: Stores persistent operational policy, claims intake, and rating data.
components.rationale: Managed relational database supporting high availability, automated backups, and converted PL/SQL logic.
trade_offs: PL/SQL migration requires manual remediation and performance tuning
components.security_considerations: Encrypts data at rest and in transit with Private Link network access.

components.name: Policyholder Identity Provider
components.purpose: Authenticates external policyholders accessing the self-service portal.
components.rationale: Provides secure, customizable identity management for end-user web applications.
trade_offs: Requires user migration and configuration of external auth flows
components.security_considerations: Implements multi-factor authentication and compliant EU user identity storage.

components.name: Enterprise Service Bus
components.purpose: Decouples asynchronous communications and claim handover events to Guidewire ClaimCenter.
components.rationale: Guarantees transactional message delivery and supports enterprise messaging patterns.
trade_offs: Requires message queue monitoring and dead-letter handling setup
components.security_considerations: Uses Shared Access Signatures and Private Endpoints for message protection.

components.validation_reason: Relies on assumption ASM_02 for batch orchestration modernization replacing Control-M.
components.name: Batch Process Orchestration Engine
components.purpose: Orchestrates nightly batch jobs, SAP postings, and Data Warehouse ETL data extracts.
components.rationale: Managed cloud data integration service capable of parallel execution to compress batch execution time.
trade_offs: Requires re-authoring existing Control-M schedule scripts into ADF pipelines
components.security_considerations: Accesses target systems via managed identities and self-hosted integration runtimes over private networks.

components.name: Document Asset Repository
components.purpose: Stores generated policy documents, schedules, certificates, and staging files before archiving.
components.rationale: Highly scaleable, cost-effective object storage with lifecycle management capabilities.
trade_offs: Requires synchronization mechanism with legacy OpenText WebDAV repository
components.security_considerations: Enforces immutability policies, customer-managed encryption keys, and role-based access control.

components.name: Central Observability Platform
components.purpose: Aggregates metrics, operational logs, and system telemetry across all cloud resources.
components.rationale: Native Azure monitoring solution providing unified log analytics and real-time alerting.
trade_offs: Requires log retention tiering configuration to balance cost and compliance
components.security_considerations: Restricts log access via RBAC and supports immutable log retention policies.

components.name: Application Insights Engine
components.purpose: Tracks backend request response latency, distributed traces, and application error rates.
components.rationale: Provides deep distributed tracing into microservices to guarantee 400ms SLA fulfillment.
trade_offs: Requires telemetry SDK instrumentation across application microservices
components.security_considerations: Masks sensitive personal data and PII in request telemetry traces.

components.name: Global Edge Security & WAF
components.purpose: Delivers edge routing, SSL offloading, and web application firewall protection against cyber threats.
components.rationale: Provides high availability and integrated DDoS/WAF protection at the cloud edge.
trade_offs: Requires global domain and routing configuration management
components.security_considerations: Filters web traffic against OWASP top 10 risks and restricts geo-location access to EU/EEA.

components.name: Enterprise Key Vault
components.purpose: Securely stores encryption keys, API credentials, and X.509 client certificates.
components.rationale: HSM-backed secure store integrated natively with Azure services via managed identities.
trade_offs: Requires strict access policy maintenance and certificate renewal automation
components.security_considerations: Access controlled via Entra RBAC with full secret access auditing enabled.

components.name: Enterprise CI/CD Pipeline
components.purpose: Automates build, test, and blue/green zero-downtime deployment pipelines across environments.
components.rationale: Integrated devops capability supporting automated release gates, approvals, and freeze enforcement.
trade_offs: Requires maintaining build agents and deployment script pipeline definitions
components.security_considerations: Enforces deployment approval gates, policy checks, and audit logging.

components.name: Infrastructure as Code Engine
components.purpose: Defines declarative infrastructure code for Norway East and West Europe landing zones.
components.rationale: Azure-native domain-specific language for reliable, repeatable environment deployments.
trade_offs: Requires learning curve for Bicep template modularization
components.security_considerations: Validated against Azure Policy for compliance before resource deployment.

environments.dev: Dedicated development environments hosted in Norway East with lightweight SKU resources and automated teardown capabilities.
environments.test: Integration and staging environments configured in Norway East mirroring production topology for load testing and validation.
environments.prod: Highly available production environment deployed across Norway East primary and West Europe secondary regions.

deployment_runtime.text: The solution leverages Azure Container Apps and Azure App Service within secure virtual network landing zones in Norway East and West Europe. Automated deployment pipelines orchestrate zero-downtime blue/green releases while adhering to annual change freeze rules.

availability_scalability.text: High availability of 99.9% is maintained using Azure Front Door multi-region routing and zone-redundant microservices in Azure Container Apps. Auto-scaling rules dynamically handle traffic peaks while database read-replicas ensure 400ms query latency SLA.

backup_dr.text: Disaster recovery is structured around Azure Database for PostgreSQL paired with geo-restorable Azure Blob Storage across Norway East and West Europe. Continuous WAL archiving and active-passive failover guarantee an RPO of 15 minutes and RTO of 4 hours.

observability.text: Azure Monitor and Application Insights collect telemetry, metrics, and trace logs across all microservices and database engines. Immutable audit logging guarantees compliance with 10-year retention rules and regulatory oversight.

security_controls.text: Security controls feature Azure Front Door Web Application Firewall, Managed Identities, and Azure Key Vault for encryption management. All personal data processing remains strictly within EU/EEA boundaries to comply with GDPR and DORA regulations.
